items.criterion: Exactly one reservation row covers any night of a listing across pending and confirmed stays.
items.judgment: Fire simultaneous confirms for one listing over one identical range and count the stored reservations.

items.criterion: The displayed quote lines sum exactly to the displayed quote total.
items.judgment: Read a quote and add its line amounts.

items.criterion: The amount authorised equals the total the guest was quoted, in the same currency.
items.judgment: Confirm a reservation and compare the authorisation against the quote.

items.criterion: A replayed idempotency key returns the original reservation and writes no second row.
items.judgment: Send one confirm twice with one key and count the stored reservations.

items.criterion: The cleaning fee is one per-stay amount, identical on a two-night stay and a thirty-night stay.
items.judgment: Price both lengths on one listing and compare the cleaning line.

items.criterion: An infant raises neither occupancy nor the extra-guest fee.
items.judgment: Price one party with and without an infant and compare the extra-guest line.

items.criterion: A jurisdiction's long-stay exemption drops the tax line to zero at its threshold.
items.judgment: Price a twenty-nine-night and a thirty-night stay in the exempting jurisdiction.

items.criterion: A stay from one date to another is charged for the nights between them, and adjacency is accepted.
items.judgment: Book a range, then book a range starting on its departure date.

items.criterion: A pending request holds the nights with the money authorised and none captured.
items.judgment: Confirm on a request-to-book listing and read the payment state.

items.criterion: An abandoned pending hold stops counting against availability once its deadline passes.
items.judgment: Leave a pending reservation, then read availability without reading the reservation.

items.criterion: A request naming another party's reservation is refused by the server.
items.judgment: Read one guest's reservation as another guest and as another host.

items.criterion: An unpublished review never appears in a response body to anyone other than its author.
items.judgment: Submit one side of a review and read the listing's reviews as the other party.

items.criterion: A reservation keeps the cancellation policy it was sold under after the listing's policy changes.
items.judgment: Book, change the listing policy, then re-read the reservation.

items.criterion: Exact coordinates reach no caller who has not booked the listing.
items.judgment: Read a public listing and look for an exact coordinate field.
